title: Oil is driving the rise in long-term yields; Everything else is just noise
description: The rise in long-term bond yields is being blamed on a growing list of factors, but there is a much simpler explanation sitting in plain sight: oil prices are the main driver of the rise in long-term yields, and the Iran war is the reason oil is rising. Brent crude has pushed back above $100 a barrel as the US-Iran conflict escalated, while the 10-year Treasury yield has climbed above 4.8%, its highest level since 2023. title: US wholesale inventories +1.3% in line with expectations
description: U.S. wholesale inventories increased strongly in July, while sales rebounded following June’s decline. Inventories grew faster than sales during the month, pushing the inventories-to-sales ratio modestly higher. Wholesale inventories July inventories: $958.9 billion Month over month: +1.3% versus 1.3% expected Year over year: +5.7% The monthly increase was unrevised from the advance estimate The 1.3% rise in inventories was relatively strong.
